email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I would like to apply for the Marketing Associate role in Stryker's Peripheral Vascular division. I am a digital marketer based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, currently combining a freelance practice with a junior digital marketing role at Episto, where I plan on-page campaigns, publish and maintain CMS content, and report on results with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs.

What draws me to this position is the range of it: supporting the execution of a product strategy, building materials that help sales conversations, coordinating events and customer engagement, and keeping the operational side — vendors, approvals, budgets — accurate and on time. My time at ViviDoctor, building front-end features for a healthcare web application, is part of why medical technology interests me more than any other sector.

I am fluent in English, work daily across markets and cultures, and would welcome the chance to talk through how I can support your team.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Associate position in Stryker's Peripheral Vascular division. I work in digital marketing at the point where content, web and analytics meet — currently through a freelance practice alongside a junior digital marketing role at Episto, and before that as a web and SEO specialist at KXP in Istanbul, supporting sites for organisations with thousands of users.

Three things from my background line up with this role. First, execution: I plan and run on-page campaigns, write and publish content in WordPress, keep CMS structures tidy — including a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages on a pharmacists' association site — and report on performance with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. Second, analysis: keyword and competitor research, technical audits and gathering market insight are the core of my daily work. Third, detail and stakeholders: I work remotely with clients and teams across Belgium, Turkey and beyond, and I have learned that approvals, deadlines and small inconsistencies are where projects either hold together or fall apart.

I also have some grounding in healthcare technology. In 2018-2019 I built and optimised front-end features for a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor, and that experience is a large part of why medical technology appeals to me more than any other sector.

I am fluent in English, based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and comfortable with a hybrid model and with travel. I am applying to learn product marketing properly — segmentation, positioning, patient pathways — and to be immediately useful in the communications and operational work that keeps marketing programmes moving.

Thank you for considering my application. I would gladly talk through any of this in more detail.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
